product_metadata.title: Marshmallow Furniture, Minnie Mouse 3-in-1 Slumber Sofa, Foam Toddler Nap Mat with Attached Blanket
features: COMFY FOAM TODDLER COUCH WITH BLANKET: Give your little one their own exclusive lounging sofa and attached matching blanket with this perfectly sized compact flip-open couch, crafted from durable and comfy foam

EASY TO UNBOX: Kids sofa ships compressed in an airtight compact box. Remove from packaging & watch it grow! Gently shaking, fluffing, and massaging your sofa will help to recover its original shape, which may take 1-3 days.

3-IN-1 SOFA, TODDLER NAP MAT & LOUNGER: Innovative flip-open construction combines kids couch, floor lounger & sleep mat for lounging, sitting, & napping. Sofa dimensions: 15"h, 29"w, and 16”d. Flips open to a 3ft kids lounger
AGES 18 MONTHS AND UP: This toddler chair is recommended for kids ages 18 months and up with a 100 pound weight capacity and one child seating capacity
MACHINE WASHABLE SOFA COVER: The polyester fabric slipcover on this convertible sofa features a safety zipper without the traditional zipper pull and is machine washable
Includes: 1 3-in-1 Slumber Sofa with Attached Blanket
Covered by the Spin Master Care Commitment. See below for full details
description: Preschoolers can sit, lounge, and sleep on their very own pull out sofa nap mat, including a built-in blanket, along with Disney’s Minnie Mouse. Just the right size for toddlers, the lightweight polyurethane foam sofa chair with removable polyester fabric slip-cover stands about 15 inches tall, 29 inches wide, and is 16 inches deep. It's decorated with fun graphics, featuring Disney's Minnie Mouse, and sure to brighten any room. Kids can use it as a traditional sofa/chair or have fun flipping the seat over to turn it into a small futon with a matching blanket! The lounger, which opens to 3ft, features vibrant and colorful graphics featuring Minnie Mouse, for even more room to play. This functional three-in-one sofa is a comfy spot for kids to sit, read stories, watch movies, eat snacks, play or take a nap! Not only is it comfortable, but durable, and easy to clean. The slip-cover can be removed using the child proof zipper on the bottom and then machine-washed with mild soap in cold water. Sofa ships compressed and will expand over time. After removal from packaging, gently shake, fluff, and massage your sofa to help recover its original shape, which may take 1-3 days. The Marshmallow Slumber Sofa is a perfect birthday gift for at home play and relaxation, practical addition to your child’s bedroom, living room, playroom, cottage, vacation, daycare and sleepovers at grandma’s or grandpa’s house for a comfy napping spot.
